## ValueTypeConstructors.double() method

A double. Finite values travel as JSON numbers (`{"double": 3}`<!-- -->); `NaN`<!-- -->, `Infinity`<!-- -->, `-Infinity`<!-- -->, and `-0` travel as explicit states. A double whose value is integral stays a double.

**Signature:**

```typescript
double(options?: ValueTypeOptions): ValueType<number>;
```
